subject: Passing values between server.R, ui.R, and a javascript function - geocoding

messages.author: 9a6ebe8eb75a29a2
messages.subject: Passing values between server.R, ui.R, and a javascript function - geocoding
parts:
I used Shiny to create an interface for (pseudo) batch geocoding the addresses in an uploaded spreadsheet and visualizing the results on a Leaflet map (repository here contains the relevant R scripts). 

Really, I'm iterating through a list of the addresses in the file and making a Google Geocoder API call each time. Currently the app uses server-side geocoding, but I would like to move to client-side geocoding so that more people can use the tool.

Does anyone have advice/pointers on how to go about passing my address values from server.R to the javascript geocoder and the geocoded addresses back to server.R, where I render the results as a data table?

Many thanks!

Emanuel

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Passing values between server.R, ui.R, and a javascript function - geocoding
parts:
Good idea!
My suggestion: 
1. when user update their datasheet, convert the dataframe to json user R2JSON, and put it into an reactive input, like, textInput. 
2. Add a function which fire when the textInput changes, something like $("#text").on('change', function(){}), the function will fetch the converted json and display it on leaflet,
3. you don't need feedback to sever.R

Good luck.
